{{Quote|Don't stop. Don't hide. Just run, and let the armor do its work.|Rebel troopers|<ref name="Galactic Hunters">{{SWGTCG|set=Galactic Hunters|cardname=Marine Rebel Armor}}</ref>}}
The '''marine armor''', also known as the '''Rebel reconnaissance armor''', was a type of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] that was used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[File:MonCals_SWG.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] wearing ''Marine armor'' and casual dress.]]
The Rebel marine armor was developed for light, modern combat and was often worn by a soldier needing to retain their agility.<ref name="SWG" /> It offered a high degree of protection against energy-based weapons like [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] but lesser protection from kinetic damage.<ref name="SWG:CU" /> The complete armor set was composed of the helmet, chest plate, left & right biceps, left & right bracers, gloves, leggings, boots and backpack.<ref name="SWG" />

==History==
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the marine armor was one the most common models of armor used by the [[Alliance Army/Legends|Alliance armed forces]]. It equipped an important number of specialized Rebel [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] such as [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]], [[Rebel Marksman/Legends|marksmen]], [[Grenadier/Legends|grenadiers]], guards and [[Warrant Officer/Legends|warrant officers]]. However, in most of the situations, Alliance troops did not wear the complete armor set but only the chest plate and leggings.<ref name="SWG" />

[[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Eker]] used to wear a green marine armor.<ref name="SWG:JtL" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a spacer retrieved nine parts of a lost Rebel marine armor while visiting multiple worlds in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and finally assembled the complete armor.<ref name="SWG:LRMA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=collection|Lost Rebel Marine Armor}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Marine armor appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Marine armor was the only Rebel armor present in the original release of the game.<ref name="SWG" /> It was later made one of the three Rebel [[W:c:swg:Faction armor|faction armors]] and adapted to the new armor system of the "[[W:c:swg:Combat Upgrade|Combat Upgrade]],"<ref name="SWG:CU" /><ref name="SonyCite-Combat Upgrade: Armor System">{{SonyCite|url=content.jsp?page=Combat%20Upgrade:%20Armor%20System|text=Combat Upgrade: Armor System}}</ref> released on [[April 27]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
